cases.name: named-this-direct

cases.name: method-this-incompatible
cases.source: const box = { base: "wrong", add(this: {base: number}, value: number): number { return this.base + value; } }; export const result = box.add(22);

diagnostics.message: The 'this' context of type '{ base: string; add(this: { base: number; }, value: number): number; }' is not assignable to method's 'this' of type '{ base: number; }'.   Types of property 'base' are incompatible.     Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number'.
